On the already loaded neural parent, execute dec.blocks.float()

conclusion: No decoder-source incompatibility identified for this selective conversion policy. Native BF16 explicit_gemm availability and memory admission remain separate checks.
caveats: The pinned reference root repository does not contain a pinned vendored TRELLIS decoder commit; setup-rocm.sh selects andyluo7/TRELLIS.2 add-rocm-support branch. This proves matching runtime policy against the independently pinned local decoder, not numerical parity with the reference installation.
HANDOVER.md reports non-finite raw decoder vertices after its BF16 policy; BF16 does not guarantee finite neural outputs.
Existing checkpoint F16-to-F32 widenings are byte-exact; F16-to-BF16 runtime conversion rounds significands and cannot use the prior round-trip proof.
The broad reference pipeline patch includes unrelated pipeline and mesh changes; only the inspected decoder conversion and algorithm/TF32 assignments belong to this neural-only policy.
